import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch.  Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# ChangeSpec name -> branch name conversion.
is_changespec = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_changespec:
        # ChangeSpec ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

## What changed

**The four declarations of the default, flipped 100 → 88:**
- `src/sase/markdown_width.py` — `DEFAULT_MARKDOWN_PRINT_WIDTH`
- `src/sase/default_config.yml` — `markdown.print_width`
- `src/sase/config/sase.schema.json` — `print_width` default
- `package.json` — prettier `printWidth` mirror

**Reflow + regeneration:** 140 Markdown files reflowed via `just fmt-md`, and every SASE-generated artifact regenerated to a fixpoint (`AGENTS.md`, provider shims, `sase/memory/*`, skill sources, prompt archives, directory-map prompts).

**Prose corrections:** `docs/axe.md`, `docs/beads.md` (×2), `docs/configuration.md` now cite `markdown.print_width` (`88`) as the source of truth instead of a bare `100`.

**Test fixes I had to make:** the full suite surfaced 5 real failures caused by the reflow — assertions that matched raw file text across what is now a line break. Fixed in `tests/test_sdd_file_writes.py` (3 `- **PROMPT:** [...](...)` rows), `tests/main/test_init_memory_handler_repo_access.py`, and `tests/main/test_init_skills_sources.py` by comparing whitespace-collapsed text.

## Verification

- **Full `just test`**: 26916 passed after the fixes (the 6th failure, `test_stall_watchdog.py::test_watchdog_keeps_hitch_and_stall_state_machines_independent`, is load-flaky — it passes in isolation; recorded as a `PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP:` note on the bead).
- **`just check`**: all lint gates green (fmt-py, fmt-md, keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, pyscripts, changelog, symvision, toobig).
- **`sase validate`**: all five checks green.

## Notes

The commit hit a rebase conflict against upstream `master` in 11 generated/docs files. I resolved by taking the upstream text and re-running the reflow + `sase memory init`, so no upstream content was lost. That resolution left the memory README's line-count table computed from pre-reflow files, which I regenerated to a fixpoint in a second commit (`b5ea6fa01`).

`sase memory init` also writes to `~/.local/share/chezmoi/home/`, so the chezmoi checkout now carries the reflowed home memory and skill files — that repo's prettier/conform alignment is phase `sase-gy.3`'s scope.
